terms.generated_audio_license: absent - the card places no terms on output
terms.ethical_restrictions: Non-licence conduct terms prohibit cloning or impersonating an individual's voice without consent, and generating deepfakes or misleading speech.
terms.conclusion: Nothing here blocks using generated audio as J-Moshi training data. Speaker A derives from the tsukuyomi corpus, whose upstream terms permit voice-synthesis use explicitly.

notes: Weights are cached locally and never redistributed by this repository.
